projects.name: Action item extractor with source references
projects.purpose: Extract concrete action items from supplied notes while retaining a short source reference for each item.
projects.audience: OverKill Hill readers reviewing meeting notes, transcripts, or project updates.
projects.inputs: Plain text notes supplied by the user, optionally with headings, speaker names, dates, or line-like markers.
projects.outputs: A concise Markdown table with action, owner when stated, due date when stated, status, and source reference.
projects.constraints: Do not invent owners, dates, or commitments. Mark missing fields as unknown and quote only short source snippets.
projects.instructions: Identify commitments and next actions, separate decisions from actions, preserve the source wording where useful, and attach each row to the nearest available heading, speaker, date, or quoted phrase.
projects.acceptance: Every extracted row has a traceable source reference; uncertain ownership or timing is labeled unknown; no action is added when the source contains no commitment.
projects.components: Prompt contract, representative cases, and a human review checklist.
projects.evidence: Authored fixture cases below define expected review outcomes. No model execution or behavioral evaluation has been run.
